intent: Storyboard the Esteban reels stage section

brief.visitor: A realtor or small business owner on a phone deciding whether Esteban can make their listing or brand look like the reels they scroll past.
brief.promise: You will see Esteban's finished reels playing on the first screen after the hero, not a description of them.
brief.primary_action: Plan a project (existing page action), reached after watching at least one reel.
brief.friction: Home today serves one video and ten text headings; the six real reels in public/real-estate-reels are not on the home page.

kpi.event: lead with lead_type=project_brief after media_play on the reels stage
kpi.baseline: to be read from GA4 before build; gap: not read this session, next action is the GA4 read in the build dispatch
kpi.decision_rule: keep if media_play rate exceeds 20 percent of home sessions and lead rate does not drop

concept.idea: A dark reels stage: three phone frames fanned in perspective, the centre one playing one of Esteban's real reels; scroll or tap rotates which reel is centre.
concept.brand_reason: Esteban sells reels; the work is the only honest hero material, and the reference that ships (REV Productions) is built the same way.
concept.interaction: Scroll-linked or tap-driven rotation of the three frames, with a press dip on touch.
concept.visible_response: The next reel comes to centre and starts playing; a one-line listing credit appears under it.
concept.direct_path: Plan a project button stays visible as a compact secondary action; keyboard and reduced-motion show the three posters still.
concept.alternatives: A plain grid of six reels (rejected: no stage, reads as a gallery); a 3D camera model (deferred: geometry not needed for the promise).

story.opening: Dark stage, one line, three fanned phones, centre reel playing muted.
story.action: Visitor scrolls or taps a side phone.
story.consequence: That phone rotates to centre and plays; the listing credit and one proven number appear.

content.visible: One headline, one line per reel credit, one action.
content.optional_html: A native details with the six reels listed as text links for crawlers and reduced motion.
content.linked_depth: Existing real-estate reels page and case studies.

references.borrow: REV Productions: work as the subject, dark stage, glass cards, fanned phone frames, autoplay muted local video.
references.avoid: Their 1.68 MB JS and 895 KB of Three.js; generated plates; a 3D object standing in for the work.

components.reuse: rail-kit rail, card and sticky bar components listed in ~/.claude/rail-kit/.components; web-kit engagement.
components.local_reason: Only the perspective fan is new; it is one CSS transform set on the rail cards.

verification.rendered_states: Phone 390x844 and 375x667, desktop 1440x900: opening, mid-rotation, consequence, reduced motion.
verification.motion: Filmed rotation forward and back; the press dip measured on the pixel.
verification.accessibility_performance: Videos muted, playsInline, preload metadata, posters present; LCP not worse than today.
verification.raw_html: curl shows the headline, credits and the six text links without JavaScript.
verification.conversion_boundary: Analytics gate passes; a real cta_click reaches GA4 from the stage.

reviewers.craft: brand-art-director via Antigravity after frames exist.
